_doc: 三源交叉驗證時發現的待後續確認問題。Key = function address, value = {name, issues: [...]}。所有 emit phase 完成後統一解決。

issues.desc: Assembly 用 FISTP + default rounding mode (round-to-nearest)；emitted C 用 (int)((double)x * 1.15) 可能產生 truncation。需實際 Watcom 9.5a 編譯後比對 codegen 確認是否等價。

EQUIVALENCE (parent-scoped, NOT the reviewed fragment): src/battle/battle.c:588 in fd2_recalculate_combat_stats loads base DX (+0x3E) via (int)*(uint16 *)(...) = ZERO-extend, but the assembly at 0x1B786 is MOVSX EAX,word ptr [EDI+0x3e] = SIGN-extend, and the sibling fd2_recompute_runtime_char_total_stats (battle.c:549) correctly uses (int)*(int16 *)(...). Sibling base-stat loads in the same parent (lines 586/587, offsets +0x37/+0x39) are correctly (int)*(int16 *). Because stat4_total (the evade value this epilogue stores) initializes from dx_total, a negative base DX would make the stored wEvade differ between rebuild and original. Fix: change battle.c:588 cast from (uint16 *) to (int16 *). This belongs to fd2_recalculate_combat_stats @0x1B750 (phase-1, separately reviewed routing entry), so it is logged here rather than blocking the 000114fb epilogue review.

Assembly uses FILD+FMUL+__CHP+FISTP (round-to-nearest by default FPU mode); emitted C uses (int)((double)per_score * multiplier_1_5). For actual values 8*1.5=12 and 24*1.5=36 the result is exact integer so truncation vs rounding doesn't matter, but Watcom codegen may differ.
Assembly 先 REP MOVSD 複製 28-dword resist table 到 stack 再索引；emitted C 直接讀 global。行為等價 (table 不在執行中被修改)，但 machine code 顯著不同。

0x10b43 fd2_noop_stub_b43 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment，正確 skip 不獨立 emit。等價性疑慮：此 fragment 的等價靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 ADD ESP/POP regs/RET』達成，而非 byte-identical。因此 Layer 2 等價驗證的責任轉移到 3 個 +0x00 parent (fd2_load_chapter_battle_data / fd2_play_rising_pre_cast_effect / fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect) 與 26 個 +0x03 parent 的 epilogue 各自 emit 時 — 屆時須確認每個 parent emit 出的 epilogue stack-cleanup 量(ADD ESP 對應其 locals + saved regs)與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點，建議記錄以免遺漏。

其餘 6 個 noop stub (c49/1011/1452/13994/15983/4e915) 仍 route 到 util/noop.c 且 done:true / reviewed:false，將在各自被 review 時逐一處理。emitter 已正確標註其為 out-of-scope(單一 function 規則)。提醒：依 calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 表，c49/1011/1452/13994 同屬 epilogue fragment(且 15983 屬 prologue adapter tail-JMP thunk)，極可能也需與 b43 相同的 skip 處理 — 屆時各自 review 時應套用同一 fragment 政策(plate marker + routing skip)，不可預先批次處理。

0x10c49 fd2_noop_stub_c49 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x10c49 = ADD ESP 0x4 + POP EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x4 + 3 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md 模式A rule A-1)，正確 skip 不獨立 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue』達成，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 等價驗證責任轉移到 3 個 tail-JMP parent — fd2_convert_battle_tiles_to_24px (JMP @0x13a3f) / fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu (JMP @0x1c13d) / fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen (JMP @0x1b418) — 各自 emit 時須確認其 epilogue stack-cleanup 量 (ADD ESP 對應 locals=0x4 + POP EDI/ESI/EBX) 與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

0x11452 fd2_noop_stub_1452 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x11452 = ADD ESP 0x20 + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x20 + 4 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md rule A-1)，正確 skip 不獨立 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue』達成，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 等價驗證責任轉移到 3 個 +0x00 全 epilogue parent — fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths (JZ @0x1df7f + JMP @0x1e0d6) / fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered (JGE @0x16b39) / fd2_render_inventory_item_grid (JGE @0x186e4)，各有 PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x20 prologue — 以及 1 個 +0x03 alt-entry parent fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template (JGE @0x1151f，無 SUB ESP、僅 POP 4 regs)。各自 emit 時須確認其 epilogue stack-cleanup 量 (ADD ESP 對應 locals + POP regs) 與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

0x13994 fd2_noop_stub_13994 是 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x13994 = ADD ESP 0x5C + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x5C + 4 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md 模式A rule A-1)，已正確 skip、不再 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性疑慮：此 fragment 的行為（caller-frame unwind + 把 EBP 載入 EAX 當回傳值）需靠唯一 parent fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear 的 return ebp_value; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue「等價」，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 跨檔語意驗證責任轉移到 parent emit 時確認：parent 的 PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x5c (@0x1f89e) prologue 對應的 stack-cleanup 段 (ADD ESP 還原 locals=0x5C + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX) 與原 binary 相同，且 MOV EAX,EBP (@0x1ff72) 的回傳值語意被 return 述句保留。非由 fragment 自身可驗，待下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

Single-read-reuse vs double-volatile-read on BIOS_TICK_WORD at 0x46C (store-to-0x539F0 + comparison): the original reuses one read; emitted C reads twice. Documented as unobservable because 0x539F0 has 0 readers binary-wide. If a wlink ORDER/byte-layout audit later cares about the exact bytes written to 0x539F0, note this write can lag the comparison value by one tick relative to the original. Recommend an inline comment in input.c near line 474 stating 0x539F0 is a dead/write-only latch (0 readers) so the double-read is intentional-equivalent.

[deferral note missing] The palette outp-stream tests (test_set_vga_palette_range_basic and siblings) defer value-level verification of the subtract/clamp arithmetic to Phase 9 integration because the test harness lacks an outp-capture stub. The risk-based test policy requires such deferral to be explicitly noted with reason ('须在输出注明延后与理由'), but no such note exists in tests/testui.c or tests/_index.md. Emitter should add either (a) a short comment at the test marking the deferral + reason, or (b) a recording outp stub so the clamp branch can be asserted (e.g. fake_pal[3]=0x05,brightness=0x10 -> expect 0; fake_pal[0]=0x3F,brightness=0x10 -> expect 0x2F).

No dedicated test for the 'cursor matches a DEAD char then a later ALIVE char' path; consider adding to testanim.c to cover the JNZ-continue branch after fd2_check_char_is_dead (currently the is_dead stub always returns 0, so the dead-skip continuation is never exercised).

fd2_walk_step_up @ 00013185: scroll-up code path (origin_y!=0 && char in top-2 rows) is not unit-tested. Same gap exists for the 3 approved siblings (down/left/right). Recommend a future consolidated test that sets origin_y!=0 with pos within top 2 rows and asserts origin_y decrements by 1 (the one non-display observable effect of the scroll branch). Deferred to Phase 9 integration per risk-based policy (rest of branch is pure blit/display).

fd2_walk_step_right @00013315 (src/anim/anim.c, testanim.c:764): test exercises NO-SCROLL arm only. UNCOVERED equivalence-relevant paths: (1) scroll arm else-branch -> scroll_delta_x=4 / scroll_window_flag=1 / composite_width=0xE / persistent data_fd2_battle_view_window_origin_x += 1; (2) right-edge-clamp OR operand data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles - data_fd2_battle_view_window_max_x == data_fd2_battle_view_window_origin_x. Both verified correct against assembly during review. Recommend a scroll-path test in Phase 9 integration (set pos_x - origin_x > 0xA with map_width - max_x != origin_x; assert origin_x incremented by 1 and cursor_screen_x unchanged). Deferred consistent with sibling walk-step down/left/up tests.

FOLLOW-UP (sibling, out of scope for this review): fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks @0x17AA9 stores data_fd2_engine_wait_n_bios_ticks_last_seen = BIOS_TICK_COUNT (full uint32) at input.c:77 and input.c:86, but its asm at 0x17abf/0x17ae7 stores the SIGN-EXTENDED MOVSX value (MOV [0x53A2C],EAX from MOVSX EAX,word ptr [0x46C]). This is the same width-equivalence class just fixed in fd2_wait_one_bios_tick. The intermediate subtraction uses (uint16)BIOS_TICK_COUNT (truncated, fine), but the two cache stores at last_seen may diverge from asm at the 0xFFFF boundary. Verify and, if confirmed, fix to (uint32)(int32)(int16)BIOS_TICK_WORD when that function is next reviewed/emitted.

TEST GAP (deferrable, not blocking): test_ai_dispatch_case11_both_execute (testbtl.c:451) makes ZERO assertions -- it is a no-crash smoke test only. Minimum strengthening: assert g_composite_call_count >= 1 (postlude reached). Currently it sets scores 7/7, calls, and resets without checking any observable.

TEST GAP (deferrable): the EAX-bug-corrected paths (case 4 pass_turn gating, case 5 item-pickup -> add_item/tile-consume/sfx/transition-to-class-7, case 7 dead-impact) and cases 9/10 are UNTESTED. They are not cheaply assertable in the current harness because the distinguishing callees (ai_ai_pass_turn_with_heal, ai_walk_to_target_tile, etc.) were promoted from counting-stubs to real implementations, so which callee ran is no longer observable. Recommend (Phase 9 integration or a harness counter-reinstatement) to cover case 5s state machine specifically, as it has the most independent logic + an EAX trap.

DEAD TEST GLOBALS: testglob.c lines 318-326 (g_attack_dispatch_return, g_attack_dispatch_calls, g_seek_optimal_return, g_advance_nearest_return, g_walk_return, g_score_physical_return, g_pass_turn_calls, g_execute_spell_calls, g_execute_physical_calls) plus their extern decls in testbtl.c (394-402) are now orphaned -- the stubs they backed were replaced by real btl_ai.c implementations. They are still referenced/reset by reset_ai_stubs() but never read for assertions. Either remove them or re-wire observable counters to make the above EAX-sensitive paths assertable.

Winner-selection coverage for fd2_attack_action_dispatch is deferred to Phase 9 integration but the deferral+reason is NOT documented in tests/testbtl.c. Policy requires noting deferral rationale for any high-risk path left uncovered. The selection logic (complex control flow + numeric tie comparisons + EAX-deref spell-damage path + no-op tie) is in the force-test category; it is left uncovered because the only observation channel is the real, un-stubbable, display-heavy executors (fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell etc. deref spell tables, call handler-table fn-ptrs, run cinematics) driven by three real scorers. Equivalence is fully verified statically, so this is logged rather than blocked, but the test file should carry an explicit deferral comment.
